ATC Playground

Issue and verify Agent Trust Cards (ATC/1.0) entirely in your browser. No backend, no signup, no data leaves your machine.
Spec: ATC/1.0 · SDK: atc-sdk@1.0.0 · Crypto: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) + RFC 8785 JCS · Source: GitHub

Paste an ATC document

Paste any ATC/1.0 JSON document — regardless of issuer. The verifier checks all 8 required controls.

Issue a new ATC

Generates a fresh CA keypair + agent keypair, signs an ATC with them, and returns the complete card. The keys are ephemeral — they live only in your browser session.

Generate a keypair

Generates a new Ed25519 keypair. Useful if you want to act as your own CA. The keys are generated in your browser — they never leave your machine.
